name: Anker 313 GaN 30W Foldable Charger PIQ 3.0 Foldable PPS
description:
Anker 313 GaN 30W Foldable Charger

Charge your devices quickly and efficiently with the compact and portable Anker 313 GaN 30W Foldable Charger. Designed for convenience and high-speed performance, it’s perfect for home, office, or travel use.

Key Features

High-Speed Charging: Equipped with 30W output, compatible with a wide range of devices including smartphones, tablets, and more.

USB-C GaN Technology: Uses advanced Gallium Nitride (GaN) technology for smaller, faster, and cooler charging.

PIQ 3.0 & PPS: Intelligent PowerIQ 3.0 and Programmable Power Supply (PPS) ensure optimal charging speed for your device.

Foldable Design: Compact and travel-friendly, easy to carry in bags or pockets.

Universal Compatibility: Works with most USB-C devices for efficient, safe, and reliable charging.
